title: 135 kagome metals: origin of correlations from Wannier models and slave spins

decision_points.fork: Pristine electron count of each model: from the archive (charge-neutral DFT, Cs 6s donated) or nominal valence
decision_points.consequence: Counts wrong; CsCr3Sb5 Zbar 0.337 and Zmin 0.135 instead of 0.268, 0.070; CsCr3Bi5 Zbar 0.728; Hund ratio 2.50 instead of 3.14

decision_points.fork: Which archive folder is CsCr3Bi5 at the CsCr3Sb5 lattice (from the .wout lattice vectors)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take CrBi_9.2 as the CsCr3Sb5-lattice model (name read as c = 9.2 A)
decision_points.consequence: Bi-lattice Zbar values exchanged (0.678 vs 0.395); sigma 1.180 instead of 1.331 eV

decision_points.fork: Order of the d Wannier functions: archive projection list (mr = 5,3,1,2,4) or Wannier90 default
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume the default order dz2, dxz, dyz, dx2-y2, dxy
decision_points.consequence: Most renormalized orbital reported as dx2-y2

decision_points.fork: Local frame of the label: the archive projection frame (x radial) or the paper frame (B3g = dyz)
decision_points.consequence: Most renormalized orbital reported as dyz instead of dxz

decision_points.fork: Separating filling from Hamiltonian: both counterfactual orders vs a single path or a cross-compound regression
decision_points.wrong_choice: One-at-a-time path or regression of ln Z on filling and bandwidth across compounds

decision_points.fork: Kinetic-energy scale: full PDOS second moment (includes d-p hybridization) vs windowed PDOS, d-d block or orbital average
decision_points.wrong_choice: Second moment of the PDOS within the plotted +-4 eV window

decision_points.fork: Hund versus Mott: the J dependence at fixed U, at the right filling
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the J dependence at the nominal count (cascade from dp1)

graded_fields: sigma_eV for CsCr3Bi5 (Sb lattice) and CsTi3Sb5 (+-3%)

length_estimate.why: Archive forensics (electron counts, lattices, projection codes), local tight-binding analysis, counterfactual SSMF design under a 20-unit budget; evaluations take 0.5-9 min each.

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); kag_ssmf.py evaluator vendored in the lab
notes: Released start with a computing lab: targets come from our numpy SSMF evaluator (kag_ssmf.py) run on the authors' archived Wannier Hamiltonians, validated against the paper (see construction README). U_c of CsCr3Bi5 is not graded: the end of the metallic branch is path dependent within ~0.3 eV and costs up to 9 min per probe.
